eigenDecision.name: Eigen
eigenDecision.scope: Inside the unmodified official PyPI wheel, downloaded at add-on install time; never committed or redistributed.
eigenDecision.statement: Approved Eigen MPL-2.0 in the audited unmodified official ONNX Runtime 1.23.2 Windows wheel only.

removed: RapidOCR and every sole dependency excluded from the selected closure; transient downloads are discarded after verified installation, while hashes and provenance remain in pins.

intelFinding.finding: MKL notice is generic for this CPU wheel: no MKL/oneDNN import and binary explicitly says oneDNN is disabled.
intelFinding.limitation: This does not prove absence of every statically linked Intel-authored instruction; no additional Intel Simplified licence entitlement is assumed.

optionalYamnet: Not downloaded: exact official artifact/licence not verified; local spectral rules remain available.
